texto: The acute accent (**´**) opens the sound of the vocal: **António** (in Portugal the first «o» is open, written with acute), **café**, **está**.
The circumfluous accent (**^**) closes the vocal: **você**, **Inês**, **avô**. In Brazil it is written * Antônio *, but in Portugal the European standard of the AO90 maintains **António**.
Respect for exact writing is required in personal registration sheets and contracts.
